Man Pleads Guilty to Bombing California Courthouse After Gun Seizure

Nathaniel James McGuire has pleaded guilty to detonating a bomb at a courthouse in Santa Maria, California, in September 2024. The bombing was reportedly in retaliation for law enforcement officers seizing his firearms earlier that year. McGuire faces a maximum sentence of life in prison for the charges.
